highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Ready for the flood: How exposure management prepares you for the Mythos vulnerability onslaught and MacOS screen sharing vulnerability actively exploited for crypto mining. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: AI-driven energy buildout raises cybersecurity, supply chain risks. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Trezor confirms shipping partner data breach affecting over 13,000 customers. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
